description: Set the reminder lead time: the account-wide default and/or a per-job override. Provide at least one of `global_default` or `job_override`, and set at least one of days/hours/minutes greater than zero. Overrides are per JOB (a job may back several schedules); get the job_id from list_schedules. Replaces any earlier override for that job. Requires the `reminders:write` scope.

global_default.description: Set (or replace) the account-wide default lead time.

days_before.description: Whole days before the shift to send the reminder (default 0).

hours_before.description: Additional whole hours before the shift (default 0).

minutes_before.description: Additional whole minutes before the shift (default 0).

job_override.description: Create or replace the lead-time override for one job.

days_before.description: Whole days before the shift to send the reminder (default 0).

hours_before.description: Additional whole hours before the shift (default 0).

job_id.description: The job this override applies to: the `job_id` shown by list_schedules or get_schedule for any schedule of that job.

minutes_before.description: Additional whole minutes before the shift (default 0).

require_sms.description: Assert SMS should be used. If true and the plan does NOT include SMS, the whole request is rejected with a message that the plan does not include SMS (nothing is saved). Omit or set false to make no assertion.

name: set_reminder_rule
title: Set a reminder rule
